chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah narrated from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who killed a bird from the birds of the Haram while he was in a state of ihram in the Haram

So he said: “He must offer a sheep, and the value of the bird is one dirham, with which he feeds the pigeons of the Haram. And if it was a chick, then upon him is a lamb, and the value of the chick is half a dirham, with which he feeds the pigeons of the Haram.”

key_terms.الْحَرَمِ: the sacred sanctuary in which special legal protections apply
key_terms.الْحَمَامِ: the sanctuary bird, here referring to pigeons/doves of the Haram
key_terms.دِرْهَمٌ: a dirham, the stated monetary value in compensation
key_terms.شَاةٌ: a sheep given as compensatory sacrifice
key_terms.مُحْرِمٌ: a person in the state of ihram during hajj or ʿumrah

ai.seo_question: What is the kaffarah for killing a bird in the Haram while in ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who kills a bird within the Haram while in the state of ihram. It specifies both sacrificial compensation and a monetary value to be spent in feeding the pigeons of the Haram, with a reduced amount if the bird killed was a chick.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2375 - Ali ibn Abi Hamzah narrated from Abi Basir, from Abi Abdullah (as):
Regarding a man who killed a bird of the sanctuary while he was in a state of ihram within the Haram,

Imam (as) said: "He must offer a sheep as compensation, and the value of the bird is one dirham, with which he should feed the pigeons of the Haram. If it was a chick, then he must offer a lamb, and the value of the chick is half a dirham, with which he should also feed the pigeons of the Haram."
